checks.name: streaming-activity
checks.details: A real health chat rendered the current-turn activity panel during streaming and completed with two safe-summary steps: context preparation and model response.

checks.name: activity-disclosure
checks.details: The timeline was collapsed by default after completion; expanding it exposed step labels, kind, status, duration, and the safety note. aria-expanded changed true/false and details hid again.

checks.name: theme-regression
checks.details: Light and dark theme controls both applied to the agent workspace; the activity panel remained visible in dark mode and the light theme was restored.

checks.name: mobile-regression
checks.details: At a 375x800 viewport the agent workspace and activity panel remained visible with no horizontal overflow (document scrollWidth matched clientWidth).

checks.name: mobile-activity-overflow-regression
checks.details: After a real streamed turn with the timeline expanded, the 375px layout kept the activity panel inside the main column and preserved the input area; the grid uses a zero-minimum single column at mobile widths.

checks.name: browser-console
checks.details: No browser console warnings or errors were observed during the smoke and regression checks.
